attributes.purpose: Keys, secrets and certificates as metadata and references, never material: ciamCredential, plus each environment's secret, key and certificate references with cloud key-service facts. Certificate expiry. Reports: credentials (sprawl), rotation-impact and expiring. The keys report's rows (placement_rows, unbound_status) live here; connectors.keys_report composes them with the installed adapters. Planner checks: certificate expiry, and key placement (HSM shortfall via hsm_shortfall, including an unrecorded protection level; carry-over; weakened stores). Secret-store inventories (inventory.py, ou=secret-inventory: ciamSecretInventory, ciamSecretObject): importer entry builders, reconciliation of secret references through adapters' locators (six states + unreferenced), rotation problems, the planner findings and the secret-inventory report rows (connectors.secret_inventory composes them with the installed adapters). Certificate managers' inventories (managed.py, ou=managed-certificates: ciamManagedInventory, ciamManagedCertificate; never an issuance record, absence never confirmed-missing): importer entry builders, vendor-neutral reconciliation of record certificates (SHA-256 > SHA-1 of the record PEM (pem_thumbprint) > serial+issuer > subject+validity; managed, renewed, revoked, disabled, in-error, not-managed; unrecorded), check_managed_certificates and the managed-certificates report.

attributes.description: Per collection source (ciamSourceRef https://<host>/<folder path>, e.g. https://tpp.example.test/VED/Policy/Example Aero): GET /vedsdk/certificates/ pages (ParentDnRecursive, Limit 500, OptionalFields Issuer,Subject) then GET /vedsdk/certificates/{guid} details up to a budget; the importer maps X509/CertificateDetails, ManagementType, Disabled, CreatedBy, Contact, Consumers, CertificateAuthorityDN, ProcessingDetails and RevocationStatus to ciamManagedCertificate facts. No public-certificate retrieval (Certificate:Manage). SaaS deferred.

attributes.description: Milestone 108 item (e), Venafi part (deferred note 3229 on file 1119; research in decision 3210). (1) Core pki: a managed/discovered certificate inventory concept, distinct from a CA's issuance record: absence from it is never confirmed-missing; what it adds (discovered certificates the record lacks, managed vs record owner/expiry/renewal) and how reconciliation and the issued-certificates report show it. This worker OWNS the core pki domain changes in this round (opsdir/opsdir/domains/pki/*); design gate to the master before coding (it changes what the record holds). Azure Key Vault certificates are expected to use the same concept later: keep it CA/vendor-neutral. (2) Venafi / CyberArk Certificate Manager, Self-Hosted (TPP, docs 26.1): a GET-only collector (GET /vedsdk/certificates Limit/Offset, ParentDn Recursive, OptionalFields; /vedsdk/certificates/{guid}) with an OAuth bearer token (credential reference, never stored), and a saved-export importer (pure). Check current permissions (docs disagree: View+Read vs Private Key Read) and the least privilege. SaaS (POST certificatesearch) only if the core POST from task 561 has merged; otherwise a deferred note. New adapter package (name at design). No local validation possible: say so in README Known limits and keep a fixture-based test. (3) Tests, showcase change, README/docs. Reserved: core attrs 920-929, classes 199-200; showcase CHG-2125, A292-A295, B117-B118.
